name: London City Airport

hours.v: aerodrome open 06:30-22:00 on weekdays, 06:30-12:30 on Saturdays and 12:30-22:00 on Sundays (local time, winter 2026/27 season)
hours.quote: Aerodrome Operating Hours ( Local ) ... Weekdays 04:45 22:00 06:30 22:00 Saturday 04:45 13:00 06:30 12:30 Sunday 10:30 22:00 12:30 22:00

curfew.v: closed outside its operating hours: no flights 22:00-06:30 on weekdays, and none from 12:30 Saturday to 12:30 Sunday; movement caps of 100 on Saturdays and 200 on Sundays
curfew.quote: Weekdays 04:45 22:00 06:30 22:00 Saturday 04:45 13:00 06:30 12:30 Sunday 10:30 22:00 12:30 22:00 ... Limit of 100 movements on Saturdays and 200 on Sundays .

max_aircraft.v: only aircraft on the airport's approved list may land; a steep approach (5.5 degrees or more) approval is required
max_aircraft.quote: Must include procedures and limitations for approach path angles of 5.5° or greater.

handling.v: Private Jet Centre with a full aviation handling service
handling.quote: The purpose-built Private Jet Centre offers exceptional customer care and a full aviation handling service.

slots.v: slots are booked for arrival and departure through the Private Jet Centre (lead time not stated)
slots.quote: Slot-booking arrangements for arrival and departure.
slots.bizav_quote: Business Aviation slot requests must be submitted to the “London City Jet Centre”. ... Jet Centre are responsible for coordinating Business Aviation aircraft parking ... will liaise with ACL to confirm runway slots.

notes: UK AIP (aurora.nats.co.uk) could not be read (robots disallowed / permission timeout), so runway, ARP and location are missing.
